headline: EA is now a private company
summary: Electronic Arts has officially become a private company. A $55 billion deal, led by Saudi Arabia's PIF, successfully closed. The PIF will reportedly own 93.4% of the gaming giant.

headline: Telegram CEO blames extortionist for App Store removal
summary: Telegram was temporarily removed from Apple's App Store. CEO Pavel Durov claims an extortionist planted CSAM in a public chat. Durov warns this creates a potential systemic risk for apps.

headline: OpenAI influencer trip sparks backlash
summary: An OpenAI influencer trip has backfired, causing controversy. It drew criticism from uninvited influencers and the public. Such trips can project frivolousness and trigger hard feelings.

headline: Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS at lowest price ever
summary: The Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS is now at its lowest price. This handheld gaming device features a Z2 Go processor. Memory and storage prices are inflated, making this a good deal.

headline: Hope for Xbox Project Helix as a premium gaming PC
summary: The author hopes Xbox Project Helix launches as a premium gaming PC. This strategy could help combat rising hardware costs. Microsoft is urged to double down on a high-end PC approach.

headline: Proton VPN 2-year plan discounted 70%
summary: Proton VPN is offering a massive 70% discount. Its 2-year plan is now available for just $2.99. This makes the 'best VPN' significantly more affordable.

headline: JSAUX Nintendo Switch 2 case holds console and dock for under $15
summary: A JSAUX carrying case for the Nintendo Switch 2 is available. It fits both the console and its docking station. The case is priced affordably at less than $15.

headline: FF7 director connects spin-offs to Revelation's ending
summary: Naoki Hamaguchi confirms more Final Fantasy VII spin-offs will tie into Revelation's ending. The director emphasizes connecting the games to the Advent Children film. This aims to unify the FF7 universe's narrative.

headline: Russian drone hunts Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari'
summary: A video shows a Russian drone chasing a terrified Ukrainian street vendor. Ukraine condemned the 'human safari' attack as a war crime. The civilian was hounded by the remotely-controlled drone.

headline: 170+ migrants rescued after Channel boat fire
summary: Over 170 migrants were rescued after their boat caught fire in the Channel. They were attempting to cross to the UK. The government states all migrants will be returned to France.

headline: Afghan boxer arrested in Greece over suitcase body discovery
summary: Afghan boxer Sharif Ahmadzai has been arrested in Greece. He is linked to the discovery of a Scottish woman's body. The body was found inside a suitcase, leading to his arrest.

headline: Oil prices drop on hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening
summary: Oil prices have fallen amid hopes the Strait of Hormuz could reopen. US officials announced progress in talks to resume shipments. Reopening the strait could stabilize global oil supplies.
